name: lurk
description: Browser extension (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) that hides Seen, story views and typing on Google Chat, Messenger, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Teams.

scripts.e2e: node scripts/build.mjs chrome && node tests/e2e/extension.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/restart.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/social.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/apps.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/stats.e2e.mjs
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.check: prettier --check . && eslint . && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tests && vitest run
scripts.safari:app: node scripts/build.mjs safari && xcodebuild -quiet -project safari/Lurk/Lurk.xcodeproj -scheme Lurk -configuration Release -derivedDataPath dist/xcode CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build && rm -rf dist/Lurk.app && cp -R dist/xcode/Build/Products/Release/Lurk.app dist/Lurk.app
scripts.safari:app:signed: node scripts/build.mjs safari && xcodebuild -quiet -project safari/Lurk/Lurk.xcodeproj -scheme Lurk -configuration Release -derivedDataPath dist/xcode -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=$DEVELOPMENT_TEAM build && rm -rf dist/Lurk.app && cp -R dist/xcode/Build/Products/Release/Lurk.app dist/Lurk.app
